extraction.name: RoboFAC Dataset
extraction.description: A large-scale and diverse dataset for robotic failure analysis and correction, comprising 9,440 erroneous manipulation trajectories and 78,623 QA pairs across 16 diverse tasks and 53 scenes in both simulation and real-world environments. The dataset includes six types of failures organized across three hierarchical levels: Task Planning Error, Motion Planning Error, and Execution Control Error.
extraction.creator: Weifeng Lu, Minghao Ye, Zewei Ye, Ruihan Tao, Shuo Yang, Bo Zhao
extraction.publisher: School of AI, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset construction pipeline involves collecting simulation data for 14 robotic tasks in the ManiSkill environment, augmented with objects from the YCB Object Dataset to increase object diversity and scenes from ReplicaCAD and AI2-THOR to enrich environmental diversity. For each custom task, an expert policy is defined by specifying target end-effector poses for each substage, and feasible paths and trajectories for the robotic arm are generated using motion planning. To generate failure data, the original expert policy is replaced with a code snippet that generates an erroneous trajectory at the selected substage. Real-world data is collected for 6 tasks via teleoperation using the SO-100 robotic arm.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Software Collection, Direct measurement, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Simulation data collected from 14 robotic tasks in the ManiSkill environment, augmented with objects from the YCB Object Dataset and scenes from ReplicaCAD and AI2-THOR. Real-world data collected for 6 tasks via teleoperation using the SO-100 robotic arm. Each robotic failure video is recorded along with a corresponding descriptive text including the substage where the failure occurred, the taxonomy of failure, and a detailed textual explanation of the error.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: To generate failure data, the original expert policy is replaced with a code snippet that generates an erroneous trajectory at the selected substage, causing the overall robotic task to fail. For failures caused by perturbations in the end-effector pose, the perturbed pose is also recorded.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Manual data cleaning was performed to remove trajectories where motion planning failed and did not align with corresponding textual descriptions. Approximately 75% of the collected data was retained after cleaning.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The raw data is annotated to construct video-based QA samples corresponding to eight question types: task identification, task planning, failure detection, failure identification, failure locating, failure explanation, high-level correction, and low-level correction. For each question type, five question templates are provided. For task identification, task planning, failure detection, failure identification, and failure locating, reference answers are directly extracted from the corresponding textual description. For failure explanation, high-level correction, and low-level correction, both the video and its corresponding textual description are used as inputs to GPT-4o to generate the reference answers. All outputs from GPT-4o were manually reviewed and corrected to ensure annotation quality.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: All outputs from GPT-4o were manually reviewed and corrected to ensure annotation quality.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: Eight question types per video, with five question templates for each type
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT-4o for generating reference answers for failure explanation, high-level correction, and low-level correction questions
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The current integration of the RoboFAC model into the VLA-controlled robotic system is not yet seamless. The success rate in real-world tasks remains subject to further enhancement, largely due to the VLA model's limited ability to follow complex natural language instructions.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training: The dataset is used to train the RoboFAC model for robotic failure analysis and correction. Testing: 10K simulated QA pairs and 8K real-world QA pairs are used for evaluation. The model is deployed as an external critic to supervise a real-world robotic arm during task execution, assessing whether it can effectively guide the VLA model and enhance the success rate of robotic tasks. The dataset enables comprehensive evaluation of multimodal models' capabilities in robotic failure video understanding across task understanding, failure analysis, and failure correction.
